notes:
Context: Northforge is a mid-market B2B SaaS search product that sells a relevance layer to vertical marketplaces. Product team evaluating Redwood for reranking endpoints.

High level ask: start with Hosted API for rapid POC (4 weeks), then transition to Dedicated for stable throughput and predictable unit economics. Primary focus: reranking endpoint (server-side top-K rescoring) + offline batch scoring for nightly re-ranks.

POC success metrics (requested by Product Lead - L. Morales):
- Offline NDCG@10 improvement >= 5% vs current model baseline
- Live top-3 click-through uplift >= 6% in 5% A/B test
- Rerank API tail latency p95 <= 350ms for 2k qps burst (preferred p50 <= 120ms)
- Batch offline scoring throughput >= 200k docs/hour for nightly jobs

Model preferences & technical notes:
- Prefer an open-model variant (13B q4-style) for Dedicated, but will accept Redwood-verified quantized variants for cost savings.
- Need rerank-specific endpoint with 'score-only' response (top-k ids + scores) and optional justification tokens.
- Offline scoring: ability to run a GPU-backed bulk scoring job + downloadable scoring artifacts (scores + feature dump).
- Evaluation: team has 10k labeled queries (NDCG, relevance grades) and wants Redwood to run native eval harness and return per-query deltas.

Security/compliance & deployment:
- Requires SOC2 attestation and SSO (SAML) before procurement.
- Data residency: customer data in US region only. Legal flagged retention policy for logs (30 days by default; want 90 days for audit).

Pricing sensitivity:
- Mid-market budgeted ARR target $30k-$120k. Very cost-sensitive around per-token/unit cost for high-volume offline scoring. Asking for a Dedicated pricing proposal with committed monthly hours + burst pricing.

Quotes & call snippets:
- Product lead: "We cannot accept regressions in top-3 precision — business impact is immediate."
- CTO: "If Redwood's offline scoring can replace our nightly Spark job, that's a big win — but price matters."

Internal notes:
- Integration work: backend search microservice (Go) will call Redwood rerank endpoint post-retrieval; expected engineering effort ~2-3 sprints.
- Will need SE whiteboard session to design batching strategy, prefix/KV caching and how to pass candidate features.

POC plan (agreed on 2026-01-14 call):
1) Week 0: security questionnaire + SAML test account provision (in parallel).
2) Week 1: ingest sample eval set (10k queries + 100k candidates), baseline offline scoring from Redwood.
3) Week 2: integrate rerank hosted endpoint into staging; run A/B on 5% traffic for read-only metrics.
4) Week 3: offline scoring throughput tuning, model variant test (quantized vs fp16).
5) Week 4: aggregate results, NDCG & CTR analysis, pricing review and Dedicated term sheet draft.
